name: Gloamwarden
title: The Lesser Rift Guardian
biography: Two young drake heads share the same cracked shrine armor. Gloamwarden guards the paths into Vaelrith’s seal and recoils when its paired breath ends.
weakness: Stone plates soften ordinary hits; both throats are exposed after either skill.

skills.name: Twin Rift Fangs
skills.description: Both heads sweep a locked violet sector. Leave the marked wedge or circle behind the drake.

skills.name: Rift Rupture
skills.description: A rupture locks onto your ground position. Move away before the fissure opens.

review.combat: Rift Rupture applied 24 player damage; reset observed.
review.phase: Distinct form observed via explicitly labelled phase rehearsal; natural threshold crossing not reviewed.
